title: Entry & Patio Door Contracts: Contract Price, Discount Programs and Warranty Plan at Signing
content:
This clause governs how the contract price of Entry & Patio Door Contracts is formed at signing, which discount program may apply, the series limits on price and units, and the warranty plan fixed at signing.

## 1. List price

At signing, the list price is the series base price per door unit times the number of units plus the options chosen.

## 2. Discount programs

One discount program at most applies to a door contract:

- **military**: active duty or veteran, shown by military identification at signing;
- **senior**: the customer is at least the minimum age on the contract signing date according to the date of birth on the customer profile;
- **first responder**: sworn police, fire or EMS, shown by department identification at signing.

When the customer qualifies for more than one program, the single program with the highest rate for the series is applied; programs never add together. The program rate is applied to the list price and the result, rounded to the cent, is the signed contract price. Discount programs are chosen at signing only.

The senior program applies only when the customer is at least the minimum age on the contract signing date according to the date of birth on the customer profile. The age is read from the date of birth recorded on the customer profile and the signing date recorded on the contract, not from the customer's statement of their age.

| Senior age test (hypothetical, minimum age 65) | Senior program |
|---|---|
| The 65th birthday falls on the contract signing date | Applies: the customer is 65 on that date |
| The 65th birthday falls on the day after the signing date | Does not apply: the customer is 64 on that date |

## 3. Series limits

A door contract may be signed only when the signed contract price reaches the series minimum contract amount and the unit count does not exceed the series maximum. Both conditions must hold.

| Signed price at or above the series minimum | Units at or below the series maximum | Contract may be signed |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Yes | No | No |
| No | Yes | No |
| No | No | No |

## 4. Warranty plan

The warranty plan is also fixed at signing: the series' included plan is the default, a higher plan is bought at signing for the Warranty Coverage upgrade price per door unit and is part of the signed contract price, a plan lower than the series' included plan cannot be chosen, and the plan never changes after signing.

## Worked figure (hypothetical)

A customer signs one standard-size unit of the Ridgeline Portal 310 Steel Entry Door (series base price $2140.00 per unit) with options chosen at signing totalling $165.00 (hypothetical). The list price is $2140.00 plus $165.00, that is $2305.00. The customer shows military identification and is also 67 on the signing date by the profile's date of birth. On the Portal 310 rates (military 10%, senior 5%), the military program has the higher rate and is the one applied; the two are not added. The signed contract price is $2305.00 less 10% of $2305.00, that is $2074.50, which reaches the Portal 310 minimum contract amount of $1995.00, and one unit is within the Portal 310 maximum of 6.
